description: Single-DGX-Spark NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (Mamba-2, attention and MoE hybrid) on Ash Hart's TensorFold 1.2.3, the native Zig engine from the creator's linux-aarch64 release archive (exact decoding; its CUDA kernels, sm_121 included, are built into the binary, so nothing compiles at start), with Vontra's MLX 4-bit (group 64) checkpoint, which includes the model's MTP draft head, launched as upstream documents it (serve the checkpoint). Upstream lists this checkpoint as checked on one GB10. One rank. Upstream's serve defaults apply: TensorFold's 16,384-token window (raise the context setting up to the model's 262,144 tokens, subject to TensorFold's startup memory check) and --parallel auto, which shares decode rounds among up to eight streams as memory allows. MTP drafting picks its chain depth from row costs measured at startup by default; the fixed-depth choices remain. Upstream measured about 123 to 146 tok/s with MTP on a 64 GB M5 Pro, an MLX run with TensorFold 0.3.5.1; no DGX Spark figure is published, and none is measured here. Needs NVIDIA driver R580 or newer (CUDA 13.0). Structured output and required tool calls use the archive's libtfgrammar (xgrammar 0.2.8). The declared memory envelope is carried over from the 0.6.6 recipe and is an estimate until the hardware sweep measures this engine. Licence, for information: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning weights are under the OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1 (text in the model repository); TensorFold is Apache-2.0 from 0.6.0 (MIT up to 0.5.0). Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Open a think block by default (upstream default: --thinking).
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B TensorFold single Spark
